messages.text: Can I get an update on my support request please
Handed to the team · Needs JD to answer the PSU and firmware rollback questions; unanswered since Sep

Simon, you've been waiting since 23 September on this and that's far too long. I'm sorry.

Your three BS-2 questions, the PSU fan cycling, a UK-safe plug-in supply, and the rollback path from the alternate OS, are back in front of JD now, flagged as priority. Stay in the chat and he'll come in here, or it reaches you by email.

If you want an answer in the next hour instead, JD is live on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate.
